title: Eufy Battery Camera Bridge for Frigate Configuration

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI or relative file path for IDE validation and autocompletion.

eufy_security_ws_url.description: WebSocket URL of your eufy-security-ws container (e.g. ws://eufy-security-ws:3000).

frigate_url.description: Frigate HTTP base URL (e.g. http://frigate:5000); also used to auto-derive go2rtc_url and rtsp_output_url when omitted.

go2rtc_url.description: go2rtc HTTP base URL (auto-derived from frigate_url on port 1984 when omitted; set only if go2rtc runs on a custom host or port).

rtsp_output_url.description: RTSP publish URL or template (auto-derived from go2rtc_url or frigate_url on port 8554; appends /{name} automatically if omitted).

ha_webhook_url.description: Optional Home Assistant webhook URL for instant trigger and Frigate event snapshot notifications.

http_port.description: Port for the built-in HTTP server (/healthz, /api/config, and POST /api/wake/:cameras). Set to 0 to disable.

width.description: Output RTSP stream width in pixels (even integer).

height.description: Output RTSP stream height in pixels (even integer).

live_fps.description: Output frame rate while a camera is streaming live or replaying a recorded clip.

idle_fps.description: Output frame rate while a camera is asleep (match Frigate's detect.fps).

audio.description: Include camera audio in the output RTSP stream.

hwaccel.description: GPU video encoding mode (false, true for "vaapi", "vaapi", "qsv", "nvenc", or "v4l2m2m"). Automatically falls back to CPU encoding if unavailable.

hwaccel_device.description: GPU render node device path when hwaccel is "vaapi" or "qsv".

cache_dir.description: Folder where clean JPEG camera snapshots are saved across restarts.

instant_event_snapshot.description: Create Frigate events after 1s of live video and use a clean cached snapshot if a wake times out.

snapshot_capture_delay_secs.description: Maximum seconds of live video to wait before creating a Frigate event when instant_event_snapshot is false.

view_cooldown_secs.description: Short pause in seconds after a camera goes to sleep before a new viewer connection can re-wake it.

view_has_priority.description: Allow a human Frigate Live View or newer equal-priority motion event to take over an active P2P stream on the same HomeBase.

backfill_delay_secs.description: Wait time in seconds after a HomeBase P2P stream finishes before downloading a recorded clip.

telemetry_poll_secs.description: How often in seconds to refresh battery, Wi-Fi, and temperature while sleeping (0 disables).

forward_face_names.description: Forward recognized person names from HomeBase 3 to Frigate sub_label and Home Assistant.

ring_label.description: Frigate event label used when someone rings the doorbell.

event_priorities.description: Priority boost per event type (e.g. {"ring": 1000, "identity person": 300, "person": 200, "motion": 10}).

cameras.description: List of Eufy cameras and video doorbells managed by the bridge.

cardPosition.description: Placement of the status card on the video frame.

sleepScreen.description: Sleeping background screen ("snapshot" for last camera frame, "slate" for dark gray, or "black").

cardShowOnLive.description: Keep the corner status card visible (Red live/replay indicator) during active streams.

autoFrigateMask.description: Automatically mask the corner status card in Frigate so status changes never trigger motion.

preserveAspectRatio.description: Keep native camera proportions (such as 4:3 or portrait doorbells) with dark sidebars.

startupSnapshot.description: Briefly wake a camera on startup if no saved snapshot exists ("always" refreshes on every restart).

holdSecs.description: Recording and event duration in seconds (default 60s, or 30s in "backfill" mode; automatically syncs to the Eufy camera, the bridge, and Frigate).

streamMaxSecs.description: Maximum continuous live session length in seconds (default 900s / 15m) when motion keeps re-triggering.

frigateEventSecs.description: Frigate event duration in seconds (defaults to matching hold_secs: 60s, or 30s in "backfill" mode).

endEarly.description: Stop recording early as soon as motion clears (default false, or true in "backfill" mode).

idleTimeoutSecs.description: Optional battery saver: close motion streams early once Frigate sees 0 active objects for N seconds (0 disables).

viewLingerSecs.description: How long in seconds to stay live after you close Frigate Live View.

viewMaxSecs.description: Maximum duration in seconds for a manual Live View session (default 300s / 5m).

useRtsp.description: Use HomeBase native RTSP (true) or P2P (false).

backfillEnabled.description: Replay recorded clips from HomeBase 3 when a P2P stream is busy or in "backfill" mode (set false on HomeBase 2).

backfillOnly.description: Use clip-replay backfill mode on events without waking a live stream.

syncPower.description: Automatically sync Eufy Power Manager settings on startup (false leaves camera settings untouched).

trackStuckSpotlight.description: Experimental: monitor idle cameras for a spotlight left stuck on (>130s after activity) and turn it off (light=false). Disabled by default while detection is refined.

enforceStreamingQuality.description: Set P2P streaming quality to 7 (1280x720) so P2P streams start quickly and do not stall at 4K (or specify an integer 1..10).

lowBatteryThreshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which unplugged cameras enter Low-Battery Saver Mode (0 disables).

lowBatteryHoldSecs.description: Shorter recording duration in seconds when a camera is in Low-Battery Saver Mode.

lowBatteryWakeOnView.description: Allow manual Frigate Live View to wake a camera while its battery is low.

telemetry.description: Show or hide specific status card telemetry items.

triggerEvents.description: Event types that wake or backfill cameras.

serial.description: Camera serial number from the Eufy app (e.g. SN0000000001).

name.description: Camera name in Frigate (defaults to serial when omitted).

title.description: Friendly display name for logs, notifications, and the "detailed" card theme (defaults to the camera's name in the Eufy app).

station_serial.description: Explicit HomeBase station serial number for multi-station P2P setups (auto-discovered when omitted).

homebase_rtsp_url.description: Custom HomeBase RTSP stream URL override if not discovered automatically from eufy-security-ws.

priority.description: Priority when two P2P cameras trigger at the same time (higher number wins).

power_working_mode.description: Eufy Power Manager mode (0 = Optimal Battery Life, 1 = Optimal Surveillance, 2 = Customize Recording).

recording_clip_length.description: Camera hardware clip length in seconds (defaults to matching hold_secs).

recording_end_early.description: Camera hardware setting to stop recording early when motion stops (defaults to matching end_early).

recording_retrigger_interval.description: Minimum pause in seconds between camera hardware motion triggers.
